game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the mine cart while the while-loop condition stays true and giant bats keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
